resources.string: No wallet yet — finish setup first.
Any Monero wallet can give here — nobody needs this app.

This one code is reused by every donor, so on Monero\'s public ledger the donations to it are linkable to each other. And a printed code is only as honest as whoever last touched it — check it is yours where you post it.
Scan with DUCAT: it opens a conversation, and your receipt lands there once the donation arrives — a record you can keep for taxes. The code renews itself after every scan.
